name: Black Book
plugin: Dragonborn.esm (last edited by UndeathFixes.esp, after Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)
canDoWhy: A chance encounter while you travel Solstheim's northern, glacier or ash regions points you to a dungeon that holds a Black Book.

starts.who: a chance encounter on the road (a person and a note are involved)
starts.where: out in the wilds of Solstheim: the northern coast, the glaciers or the ashlands
starts.how: Travel those parts of Solstheim. When the encounter fires, you learn which dungeon holds a Black Book.

firstStep: Find the Black Book in the dungeon the encounter names

takesYou.place: a dungeon on Solstheim, chosen when the quest starts
takesYou.why: a Black Book is hidden there

objectives: Find the Black Book in <the dungeon named>

opens: the Black Book's own quest, once you read the book you find (which book is not in these files)

people.name: a person met on the road (unnamed in the records)
people.role: part of the encounter that starts the quest

unsure.why: The quest starts from a script event in three Solstheim regions. These files don't say what the encounter looks like: who the person is, whether they're alive, or where the note is.
The dungeon and the Black Book are picked when the quest starts. The files don't list which dungeons or which book.
UndeathFixes.esp edits this quest last, but these files don't show what it changes. It may be tied to Undeath's own Black Book (Whispers of the Veil), but that is not confirmed.
Which Black Book quest follows depends on the book the alias picks, and the records here don't say.

evidence: QUST Dragonborn.esm:027A14 DLC2WE06, type Misc, editedBy USSEP then UndeathFixes.esp; stages 0-255 have no log text
objective 1 'Find the Black Book in <Alias=Dungeon>'; aliases TRIGGER, myHold*, TravelMarker1, Actor1, Dungeon, BlackBook, Note
quest_givers_raw starts: DLC2WERegionNorthQuestNode, DLC2RegionGlacierQuestNode, DLC2WERegionAshlandQuestNode (script event)

name: Black Book: Untold Legends
canDoWhy: Starts the moment you read the Black Book "Untold Legends"; it pulls you into Apocrypha.

starts.who: the Black Book "Untold Legends" (the book itself)
starts.how: Read "Untold Legends". You are pulled into Hermaeus Mora's realm of Apocrypha and the quest begins.

firstStep: Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge

takesYou.why: the book pulls you into Hermaeus Mora's realm; find the hidden knowledge there, or read the book again to escape

choices.choice: Read the book again before finishing
choices.leadsTo: You escape Apocrypha; the quest stays open for another try

objectives: Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge

unsure.why: These files don't say where this Black Book lies in the world, so the planner can't send the player to it yet.
No conditions on the book or the quest show up here, so any main-quest gating on finding or reading it can't be checked.

The records hold the Black Book powers (Mora's Boon, Omen of Warding, Secret of Arcana, Secret of Protection, Secret of Strength), but nothing in these files ties any of them, or any other reward, to this book.
The log says reading the book again lets you escape. Whether the quest really stays open afterwards is a guess, since only the opening and closing log entries exist.

evidence: QUST Dragonborn.esm:03216C DLC2BlackBook03Quest: two stages, opening log 'I read the Black Book called "Untold Legends"... read the book again to escape', closing stage completes; objective 10 'Learn the Black Book's hidden knowledge'; alias Book03Target
quest_givers_raw: no people, no start event, no rewards
powers_raw: DLC2BlackBook*Spell powers exist with no link to a specific book ; quest_starts_raw line 'black-books' opens with this quest, no conditions

name: The Ebony Warrior
canDoWhy: A warrior in ebony armor walks up to you in the streets of a city and challenges you to fight him at his last vigil.

starts.where: in the streets of whichever city you are entering when the encounter fires
starts.how: He comes to you when you arrive in a city and tries to talk. Talk to him and he challenges you to meet him at the Last Vigil.

takesYou.why: where he waits to fight you

choices.choice: Meet him at the Last Vigil and fight
choices.leadsTo: You defeat the Ebony Warrior and the quest completes: 'May his soul find rest in Sovngarde.'
You dismiss his challenge; he looks dejected and the quest completes with no fight

objectives: Talk to the Ebony Warrior
Meet the Ebony Warrior at the Last Vigil
Tell him to get lost

rewards.what: His ebony gear, looted from his body
The forge recipes for Vitreous Ebony Armor, Boots, Gauntlets, Helmet and Shield and the Savage Ebony Scimitar (you also need the Ebony Smithing perk)

closes: The Ebony Warrior dies if you fight him; dismissing him also ends the quest

people.name: Ebony Warrior
people.role: challenger; the records place him at the Ebony Warrior's Camp until he seeks you out

people.name: Shadowmere
people.role: the quest keeps track of Shadowmere; the records don't say why

unsure.why: The only start condition here is that the encounter hasn't already fired. No level requirement shows up in these files, though the story event may carry conditions that weren't extracted.

These files don't say where the Last Vigil is or what hold it's in. The Ebony Warrior is placed at 'Ebony Warrior's Camp' in Skyrim, and Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil adds an interior called Ebony Keep there, but the link between them isn't spelled out.
He picks the city when the encounter fires on a location change. The files don't list which cities qualify.

His outfit comes from Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil - Ebony Warrior Overhaul, but the pieces in it aren't listed. The forge recipes check only that the quest is complete, and both endings complete it, so dismissing him may unlock them too.
EbonyGetLost.esp adds a second Ebony Warrior and a tied reference with no cell. Whether you can still fight him after dismissing him isn't clear from these files.

evidence: QUST Dragonborn.esm:02C49E: stage 10 log 'tried to talk to me on the streets of <StartCity>', stage 100 challenge, 200 defeated (completes), 250 dismissed (completes); objectives 10/100/150
quest_givers_raw: giver Ebony Warrior Dragonborn.esm:0285C3 at Ebony Warrior's Camp (cell Skyrim.esm:000D74); start node DLC2EbonyWarriorNode change location
quest_starts_raw: event condition DLC2EBRun == 0; EbonyGetLost.esp changes opening dialogue INFO 02C439 from stage < 100 to <= 100
recipes_raw: Ryn_RecipeArmorEbony* need GetQuestCompleted 02C49E + REQ_Smithing_EbonySmithing
people_schedules_raw: outfit Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil - Ebony Warrior Overhaul.esp:00080B; EbonyGetLost.esp:000806 second NPC

name: Deathbrand
plugin: Dragonborn.esm (last edited by Unofficial Skyrim Special Edition Patch.esp)
canDoWhy: Visit Haknir's Shoal on Solstheim, where pirates have dug up an old chest; their treasure map leads you to Haknir Death-Brand's armor and tomb.

starts.where: Haknir's Shoal, a pirate camp on Solstheim
starts.how: Go to Haknir's Shoal. The pirates there have uncovered a buried chest holding a piece of stalhrim armor, and the journal asks you to learn more.

firstStep: Learn more about the buried treasure at Haknir's Shoal

takesYou.why: the pirates and their treasure map

takesYou.place: the spots marked on the Deathbrand Treasure Map
takesYou.why: dig up the chests holding Haknir's armor; one also holds the Gyldenhul Barrow Key
Haknir's tomb, his cursed gold and his swords

objectives: Learn more about the buried treasure
Use the Deathbrand Treasure Map to find the treasure
Explore Gyldenhul Barrow
Defeat Haknir Death-Brand

rewards.what: Deathbrand Helm, Deathbrand Cuirass, Deathbrand Gauntlets and Deathbrand Boots (light stalhrim armor; each piece's effect is strongest with the full set)
rewards.when: from the chests on the treasure map
from the pirate leader at Haknir's Shoal
in one of the treasure chests

rewards.what: Haknir's two swords and his gold
rewards.when: in Gyldenhul Barrow, after you defeat his ghost

people.name: Pirate leader
people.role: leads the pirates at Haknir's Shoal and carries the book Deathbrand

people.name: Haknir Death-Brand
people.role: the legendary pirate king; his ghost attacks in his tomb in Gyldenhul Barrow

people.name: Haknir's Crew
people.role: his ghostly crew in Gyldenhul Barrow; touching the cursed gold seals the doors behind you

unsure.why: No start event or opening dialogue shows up for this quest. The first log is written at Haknir's Shoal, so it probably starts when you arrive there, but that isn't shown.
The four chests are quest aliases. These files don't give where the map marks them or which one holds which piece and the key.
Both places are on Solstheim, but they have no map markers in these files, so the 'next to Skaal Village' distance there can't be trusted.

Haknir's swords aren't named in the quest records. ArteFake's replicas of them are called Bloodscythe and Soulrender, which suggests the originals carry those names, but that isn't confirmed. Who holds the treasure map, the leader or another pirate, isn't spelled out either.
Danger: these files list Haknir Death-Brand as a level 200 boss in Gyldenhul Barrow (enemies there run 40 to 200), and the pirates at Haknir's Shoal as 10 to 50 with a leader at 19 to 24.

canDoWhy: Meet Ralis Sedarys outside the ash-buried Kolbjorn Barrow on Solstheim and agree to pay for his dig.

needs.what: 11,000 gold over the whole quest (1,000, then 2,000, 3,000 and 5,000)

starts.where: outside Kolbjorn Barrow on Solstheim (Raven Rock is the nearest town)
starts.how: Go to Kolbjorn Barrow and talk to Ralis. The barrow is buried in ash, and he offers to make you a partner in the dig if you pay for it.

firstStep: Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (1000 gold)

takesYou.why: the dig site; you come back after each payment to clear draugr and push deeper
find Ralis performing the ritual that frees Ahzidal, and fight Ahzidal

choices.leadsTo: You decide he sacrificed the miners on purpose and kill him for his crimes
You accept that Ahzidal controlled him and let him leave in peace. He says he'll go to Raven Rock and lend you a hand if you need it

objectives: Fund the excavation of Kolbjorn Barrow (1000 gold)
Wait for a message from Ralis
Visit the Kolbjorn Barrow Excavation
Clear the Draugr from Kolbjorn Barrow
Find a way deeper into the Barrow
Speak to Ralis
Fund the next phase of the excavation (2000 gold)
Wait for a message from Ralis
Return to Kolbjorn Barrow
Clear the Draugr from Kolbjorn Barrow
Search for the missing miners
Speak to Ralis
Fund the next phase of the excavation (3000 gold)
Wait for a message from Ralis
Return to Kolbjorn Barrow
Clear the Draugr from Kolbjorn Barrow
Speak to Ralis
Fund the next phase of the excavation (5000 gold)
Wait for a message from Ralis
Return to Kolbjorn Barrow
Locate Ralis
Defeat Ahzidal
Confront Ralis
Kill Ralis

rewards.what: The Relics of Ahzidal, sealed in Kolbjorn Barrow. The records hold Ahzidal (mask), Ahzidal's Armor, Ahzidal's Boots, Ahzidal's Gauntlets, Ahzidal's Helmet, Ahzidal's Ring of Arcana and Ahzidal's Ring of Necromancy
rewards.when: inside the barrow, as you dig deeper and after you defeat Ahzidal

closes: Ralis Sedarys dies if you choose to kill him
The miners Bradyn and Mireli are found dead
Ahzidal is destroyed, which also counts for Destroy the Acolyte Priests

people.name: Ralis Sedarys
people.role: the explorer running the dig; waits outside Kolbjorn Barrow at first

people.name: Ahzidal
people.role: the dragon priest sealed in the barrow; boss of the last phase

people.name: Bradyn
people.role: missing miner, found dead in the barrow

people.name: Mireli
people.role: missing miner, found dead in the barrow

people.name: Geldis Sadri
people.role: at the Retching Netch in Raven Rock, passes on the rumor that Ralis wants gold to dig out Kolbjorn Barrow

unsure.why: Ralis is placed in the Solstheim wilds and has a package keeping him near the barrow until the dig is funded. After that his only packages are sleeping and sandboxing at the Retching Netch. Where he stands during each phase comes from the quest, and that isn't in these files.

The log calls the Relics of Ahzidal 'sealed in Kolbjorn Barrow', and the records hold those items, but these files don't say where each one lies. Ralis is in the potential-follower faction and promises to 'lend you a hand' if spared, but the dialogue that recruits him isn't shown.
The quest uses an easy Speech check somewhere. These files don't say which line, possibly the one that persuades Ralis or spares him.
Ralis is marked essential in his record. The kill ending must lift that, but the script isn't read here.
Danger: these files list Kolbjorn Barrow's enemies at levels 30 to 55, with Ahzidal at level 55.
